response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine interest in developer tooling (test runners, MCP code generators, a C IDE at National Instruments), but the core requirements of this role are largely unmet: there is no meaningful Java or Kotlin depth, no Spring or enterprise JVM framework experience, and no demonstrated JVM internals expertise. His career centers on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, making him a weak match for an enterprise JVM IDE position despite solid general seniority.
strengths: Direct IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI in C/C++)
Strong developer-tooling track record (test frameworks, code generators, CI/CD infrastructure)
Broad, senior-level polyglot experience with performance-sensitive systems (DLang, async I/O at scale)
concerns: No substantive Java or Kotlin experience; Java only mentioned peripherally
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM ecosystem exposure
No evidence of deep JVM internals knowledge, a hard requirement for the role
